items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Run the gate implementation from a trusted revision**

Because the preceding checkout places the review worktree at the PR-controlled head, this `make` executes that head's `Makefile` and `scripts/require-crit-review.py`. A PR that changes either file can redefine `require-crit-review` to return success—or execute arbitrary commands with the orchestrator's credentials—so none of the purported mandatory evidence checks need run. Invoke a gate implementation loaded from the trusted base checkout while pointing its Git operations at the PR worktree.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/0749e9317e2ec412e96d09360d3168505c91913f/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refuse symlink destinations before copying evidence**

When the PR head contains one of these evidence paths as a symlink, `cp` follows the destination link before the gate gets a chance to validate that evidence remains repo-local. For example, a committed `.orchestration/validation/<task>-crit.json` symlink can make this privileged integration step overwrite an arbitrary host path with the source evidence. Resolve and verify every destination beneath the review worktree, or remove/recreate each destination without following links, before copying.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/0749e9317e2ec412e96d09360d3168505c91913f/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Clear the inherited gate-disable override**

If the invoking shell has exported `CRIT_REVIEW=off`, this command inherits it because only `AUDIT_DISPOSITIONS` is unset; the Makefile forwards that value and `require-crit-review.py` returns success before checking the sweep, acceptance record, audit, or review receipt. The wrapper consequently reports `gate rc=0` without running its mandatory gate, so explicitly unset or override `CRIT_REVIEW` for this integration invocation.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/0749e9317e2ec412e96d09360d3168505c91913f/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)
